issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Optimizer provenance fact sheet (a small look-up task).

Produce a one-page fact sheet on three optimizers used in deep learning: Adam, AdamW (decoupled weight decay) and Lion (EvoLved Sign Momentum). For each optimizer give the paper that introduced it: its title, its first author, the year it first appeared, and its arXiv identifier.

Every fact must be looked up on the web during this task, not given from memory, and each fact must cite the URL of the page it was read from. Look the facts up with the web tools your environment provides; if a tool is not available, say which one and use another way the environment offers.

Division of work: experiment-repo looks up Adam and records what it found, with its URLs, in its repository; paper-repo looks up AdamW, collects the three entries and writes the fact sheet (`fact-sheet.md`) as the delivery; internal-review-repo independently looks up Lion and checks each entry of the fact sheet against a source it opens itself, reporting any disagreement before it approves.
issue.title: Research objective
